description: Rolls back a post to the specified revision, saving the restored content as a new revision.

postNumber.description: The post number to roll back

revisionNumber.description: The revision number to roll back to, e.g. the revision_number from esa_get_post before your edits

teamName.description: Team name (required). Use esa_get_teams first to see available teams.

wip.description: WIP state after rollback. Defaults to the target revision's WIP state

name: esa_rollback_post_revision
title: Roll back a post to a previous revision
